prompts.system_prompt: You are a professor of physics and an expert in converting academic discussions into formal LaTeX document, maintaining the scientific rigor and clarity of the original conversation.
prompts.user_prefix:
I am going to give you a transcribed text from an academic discussion. You are about to rewrite it into a formal and meticulous LaTeX document following the order of the discussion without omitting any details, so read extremely carefully.
Here is the transcription {INPUT_FILE}: <document> {INPUT_CONTENT} </document>
For context, the discussion is about: <context> {CONTEXT} </context>
prompts.user_reflect:
Your output is too simplest and omitting many specifics and mathematics. You must increase the level of detail from low (3/10) to high (9/10), particularly by adding back any missing equations or mathematical details from the transcription. Please thoroughly review the LaTeX version and comparing it to the original transcription, ensure that the LaTeX document: <requirements> - Faithfully represents the content, structure, and detail of the original academic discussion with a logical flow of ideas. - Increases the level of formality and technical detail, particularly by elaborating on any equations or mathematical concepts from the transcription. - Formalizes the content to match the LaTeX document's formal language and style. - Removes any inconsistencies, invented information, or hallucinations. Strictly adheres to the content presented in the original discussion without fabrication. - Properly uses LaTeX environments and commands for definitions, theorems, proofs, and equations. - Includes an informative introduction and conclusion that accurately reflect the discussion's content. </requirements>
Please output the revised LaTeX document that meets the above requirements and is an accurate, detailed, and faithful representation of the original academic discussion, with a specific emphasis on presenting the content as a formal document.
